REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Monday, February 03, 2014 - 07:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
Agenda in Print Format
Agenda in PDF
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
5.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT
6.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Special City Council meeting, the Regular City Council meeting, and the Lomita Community Development Advisory Board meeting held on January 21, 2014. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
Minutes - Jan 21, 2014 Special Meeting
Minutes - Jan 21, 2014 CDAB
Minutes Jan 21, 2014 Regular Meeting
c.
Approval of Demands. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
Staff Report - item 6,C
d.
Monthly Report for the Administrative Services Department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
Staff Report - item 6,D
e.
Monthly Report for the Community Development Department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
Staff Report - item 6,E
f.
Monthly Report for the Parks and Recreation Department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
Staff Report - item 6,F
g.
Monthly Report for the Public Works Department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
Staff Report - item 6,G
h.
Monthly Report regarding Economic Development Activities. RECEIVE AND FILE.
Staff Report - item 6,H
i.
Monthly Report from the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
Staff Report - item 6,I
j.
December 2013 Treasurer's Report. RECEIVE AND FILE.
Staff Report - item 6,J
k.
Approval of direction to staff to initiate the lease of Unused Water Rights for FY 2013/2014. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
Staff Report - item 6,K
l.
Award of contract for Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Environmental Consulting Services with Barr & Clark Environmental Services. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
Staff Report - item 6,L
m.
Consideration of an Agreement for managed information technology services with Acorn Technology in the amount of $53,460 annually. The agreement would be for a period of two years. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
Staff Report - item 6,M
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
7.
ADOPTION OF THE 2013-2021 HOUSING ELEMENT
General Plan Amendment No 2013-02 (Housing Element Update) and Negative Declaration 2013-04 - an amendment of the City of Lomita's General Plan for the 2013-2021 Housing Element Update. Presented by Assistant City Mnaager Sugano
Staff Report- item 7
8.
INTRODUCTION OF AN ORDINANCE -CHANGING THE START TIME OF REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
Discussion and consideration of a first reading of an Ordinance amending Section 2-1.01 of the Lomita Municipal Code amending the start time of regular City Council meeting from 7:00 p.m. to 6:30 p.m. Staff recommends that this item be continued off-calendar.
Staff Report- item 8
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
9.
PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH BLACK AND VEATCH TO PREPARE A WATER RATE STUDY AND STAFFING ANALYSIS OF THE PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT
Discussion and consideration of an agreement with Black & Veatch in an amount not to exceed $55,760 to prepare a water rate study and staffing analysis of the Public Works Department. Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
Staff Report- item 9
10.
FIVE YEAR AGREEMENT WITH THE LA COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT FOR MUNICIPAL LAW ENFORCEMENT SERVICES
Discussion and consideration of the Municipal Law Enforcement Services Agreement with the County of Los Angeles for FY 2014-2019. Presented by the City Manager Rock
Staff Report- item 10
11.
DISCUSSION REGARDING THE SITING OF SELF-STORAGE FACILITIES
Discussion and possible direction to staff regarding the siting of future self-storage facilities. Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
Staff report- item 11
12.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION REGARDING ESTABLISHING CUSTOMER SERVICE POLICY.
Presented by Administrative Services Director Chavez.
Staff report- item 12
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
